The fort is located near the village of Aldona, approximately 12 km from Panaji, Goa’s capital.

The fort was built by the Portuguese in the early 18th century as a defense post. It played a significant role in protecting the area against invasions and provided strategic views of the surrounding land.

No, the fort is usually open to the public free of charge.

Yes, Corjuem Fort is worth visiting for its historical significance, picturesque surroundings, and peaceful ambiance. It is an excellent spot for history buffs, photographers, and nature lovers.
